purpose: Define runtime errors as explicit machine-readable evidence identities separate from the operation, execution, Event and resource that produced them.

topics.name: Runtime Error Identity
topics.purpose: Define runtime errors as explicit machine-readable evidence identities separate from the operation, execution, Event and resource that produced them.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant error occurrence has an explicit error/evidence identity.
semantics.code_rule: Stable error type/code identity is separate from occurrence identity.
semantics.source_rule: Error references exact originating component/operation/execution/step where available.
semantics.message_rule: Human message is descriptive and never the error semantic identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Error content grants no remediation authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: free-text message used as error identity
error occurrence reused as operation identity
root cause guessed from log proximity

references.purpose: Runner failures retain exact execution provenance.
